publication.publisher_or_container: E.J.W. Gibb Memorial / Luzac & Co. (later Gibb Memorial Trust)
publication.edition: Nicholson critical edition and translation, 8 volumes (1925-1940)

verification.verification_notes: Nicholson's Gibb Memorial edition (first volume 1925) verified via Open Library. Used for the Sufi didactic-sacred form: homely anecdote turning into ecstatic figure (the reed cut from its bed; sun and ocean), and union framed as self-annihilation; described structurally, no passages reproduced.

limitations: Persian prosody, pun, and Qur'anic allusion are not fully recoverable; later popular translations (e.g. loose English 'versions') are unreliable for acoustic claims. This dossier uses Nicholson's scholarly edition.

copyright.notes: Gibb Memorial edition/translation rights vary; analytical citation only; no passages reproduced.
